customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be among the best in the market, offering good value for money with transparent pricing. The installation process is excellent, and the purifier works properly, with one customer noting the mineraliser and alkaline filters perform well. They appreciate its premium appearance and consider it a fantastic investment for safe, clean drinking water. The water quality receives positive feedback, with customers reporting noticeable improvements, though opinions on taste are mixed.

reviews.author: Vaibhav Patil
reviews.title: Excellent product
reviews.body: Excellent product. It's been more than 1.5 years and still going strong. No issues with water till date. Beware of installation agent they suggest you to install pressure reducer valve or booster pump even when it is not required. It you water tank is on height of 3 house floor. You may need a reducer. But always check the pressure on his device whenever they measure the pressure.

reviews.author: Philosopher Stoned
reviews.title: Go for it without a 2nd thought. Worth every penny
reviews.body: The best filter in the market. Worth the price. UC made it easy for me Only minor drawback is storage capacity

reviews.author: SJ
reviews.title: Peace of mind guaranteed!
reviews.body: Wonderful product with no other hidden charges, everything is covered! just sit back and relax for 2 years! really surprised by the service promptness in specified time & prompt follow up post delivery & installation felt really good...

reviews.author: Dada Khalandar
reviews.title: Impressive TDS reduction and hassle-free ownership!
reviews.body: Outstanding performance and total value for money! Highly impressed with the Native M1 by Urban Company. Our input water TDS was extremely high at 1190, and this purifier brought it right down to a clean 134. The promised 2-year zero filter change feature makes it an absolute game-changer—no maintenance hassle for two full years. Delicious, clean drinking water. Highly recommended!
